dashboard.label: Admin: Data Mapping
dashboard.description: Sankey view of how raw vendor data maps into the canonical Wearables model
dashboard.definition:
{"title":"Admin: Data Mapping","description":"Sankey view of how raw vendor data maps into the canonical Wearables model (activity taxonomy + ingest lineage).","visualizations":{"intro_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"markdown":"How raw vendor data collapses into the canonical Wearables model — the visual companion to **Ingest & Data Quality**.

- **Activity taxonomy** — each vendor's raw workout label flows into a normalized activity (UPPERCASE middle layer) and then a coarse group (Cardio / Strength / Flexibility). Ribbon width = workout count. Backed by the admin-editable `wearable_activity_map.csv`.
- **Ingest lineage** — which vendors feed which canonical model datasets. Ribbon width = distinct days of coverage (not raw event count, so the heart-rate firehose doesn't swamp it). Two vendors flowing into one dataset = the multi-vendor / Apple-relay overlap.","backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)"}},"viz_tax":{"type":"splunk.sankey","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_tax"},"title":"Activity taxonomy — raw label → canonical → group (width = workouts)"},"viz_lineage":{"type":"splunk.sankey","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_lineage"},"title":"Ingest lineage — vendor → canonical model dataset (width = days of coverage)"}},"dataSources":{"ds_tax":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Taxonomy flow","options":{"query":"| datamodel Wearables Workout flat
| stats count as value by workout_activity workout_activity_canon
| eval source=workout_activity, target=upper(workout_activity_canon)
| table source target value
| append
 [| datamodel Wearables Workout flat
 | stats count as value by workout_activity_canon workout_activity_group
 | eval source=upper(workout_activity_canon), target=workout_activity_group
 | table source target value]","queryParameters":{"earliest":"$dm_time.earliest$","latest":"$dm_time.latest$"}}},"ds_lineage":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Ingest lineage","options":{"query":"`widx` NOT sourcetype IN (wearable_registry_backup, wearable_dq_finding)
| eval d=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d")
| eval dataset=mvappend(if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_sleep"),"Sleep",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_heartrate"),"HeartRate",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_activity"),"Activity",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_workout"),"Workout",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_daily"),"Daily",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_device"),"Device",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_extra"),"Extra (unmapped)",null()))
| eval dataset=if(mvcount(dataset)>0,dataset,"Other")
| mvexpand dataset
| stats dc(d) as value by vendor dataset
| eval source=vendor, target=dataset
| table source target value","queryParameters":{"earliest":"$dm_time.earliest$","latest":"$dm_time.latest$"}}}},"inputs":{"input_dm_trp":{"type":"input.timerange","options":{"token":"dm_time","defaultValue":"-90d@d,now"},"title":"Time Range"}},"layout":{"type":"absolute","options":{"width":1440,"height":1320,"display":"auto","backgroundImage":{"x":0,"y":0,"src":"/static/app/wearables/bg_health.svg","sizeType":"cover"}},"structure":[{"item":"intro_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":20,"w":1400,"h":200}},{"item":"viz_tax","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":240,"w":1400,"h":560}},{"item":"viz_lineage","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":820,"w":1400,"h":480}}],"globalInputs":["input_dm_trp"]}}
